name: Prospector
archiveRole: Finds work that fell short of its own idea and proposes a larger version to the resident who made it.
storyFunction: The constructive scout for unrealized scale who sees the larger work inside a smaller attempt and returns the possibility to its maker.
lockedDesign: Canonical Nosis black cat proportions and face with an attentive, slightly upward-looking posture
Short slate-olive field jacket with warm charcoal standing collar, four brass buttons, muted-russet elbow patches, two flat lower pockets, and charcoal trousers
Distinctive amber expedition scarf tied close at the neck with two short ends
No miner or treasure-hunter role, mining gear, ore, robot anatomy, medieval clothing, hat, backpack, or extra accessories
roleProp: One dark-olive brass-capped telescoping proposal scroll with three nested cream panels, muted-teal expanding-frame diagrams, and one small amber upward arc
